claims: Siemens AG is a German multinational technology conglomerate specializing in industrial automation, infrastructure, transportation, and healthcare.
Siemens was founded in 1847 by Werner von Siemens and Johann Georg Halske.
Siemens is headquartered in Munich and Berlin.
Siemens has a Digital Industries division for automation and software.
Siemens has a Smart Infrastructure division for smart grids and buildings.
Siemens has a Mobility division for transportation and rail solutions.
Siemens Healthineers is a key business division of Siemens for medical technology.
